resident_verification_consent_cleanup
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resident_verification_consent_cleanup()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN
 PERFORM erase_resident_verification_subject(NEW.user_id); RETURN NEW;
END $function$

resident_verification_price_allowed
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resident_verification_price_allowed(owner_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
AS $function$ SELECT NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resident_verification_cohorts WHERE user_id=owner_id) $function$

functions.name: resident_verification_price_guard
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resident_verification_price_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN
 PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(NEW.user_id::text,0));
 IF NOT resident_verification_price_allowed(NEW.user_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'resident_verification_required'; END IF; RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: resident_verification_social_projection
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.resident_verification_social_projection(links jsonb)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(platform,urls),'{}'::jsonb) FROM (SELECT lower(substring(value#>>'{}' from '(?i)^https://([^/:?#]+)')) platform,jsonb_agg(value) urls FROM jsonb_array_elements(coalesce(links,'[]'::jsonb)) GROUP BY 1) grouped
$function$

triggers.name: resident_verification_consent_cleanup
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER resident_verification_consent_cleanup AFTER INSERT ON consents FOR EACH ROW WHEN (new.consent_type = 'client_messaging'::text AND (new.decision = ANY (ARRAY['denied'::text, 'revoked'::text]))) EXECUTE FUNCTION resident_verification_consent_cleanup()

triggers.name: resident_verification_quote_guard
